pokedexEntries.su: Its body is capable of storing electricity. On camping trips, people are grateful to have one around.

pokedexEntries.mo: From the food it digests, it generates electricity, and it stores this energy in its electric sac.

pokedexEntries.us: It buries itself in fallen leaves and barely moves, munching away on humus. If you accidentally step on one, you’ll get a shock!

pokedexEntries.um: Its stout shell provides excellent defense from attacks. It uses electricity on persistent opponents.

pokedexEntries.sw: While its durable shell protects it from attacks, Charjabug strikes at enemies with jolts of electricity discharged from the tips of its jaws.

pokedexEntries.sh: Its digestive processes convert the leaves it eats into electricity. An electric sac in its belly stores the electricity for later use.

pokedexEntries.sc: Protected by a sturdy shell, Charjabug eats large quantities of fresh and decomposing leaf litter in order to evolve.

pokedexEntries.vi: As it digests fallen leaves, it generates and stores electricity, which it can discharge from the tips of its jaws.
